title: Hearty Citrusy Japanese Rice Gyoza
description: A Japanese Tohoku dish featuring citrusy and creamy flavors, made with ready rolled shortcrust pastry and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, perfect for meal prep. This dish is nut-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked Japanese rice, grind rice khao khuha, orange marmalade, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, salt, and black pepper.
Place small spoonfuls of the rice mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Place the gyoza on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little bit of water.
Bake the gyoza in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the gyoza hot and enjoy.
